source: Supplied directly by the owner, August 2026. Current professional set — these supersede the older interior shots carried over from the previous website. Photos 17-20 are frames lifted from the interior walk-through video she sent after her August 2026 review — the only footage of the house since the repaint and refurnish, and the only interior imagery on the site that postdates it.
